sections.shortTitle: Capital Issues Continuance of Control Amendment Ordinance 1965
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE CAPITAL ISSUES (CONTINUANCE OF CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
THE CAPITAL ISSUES
(CONTINUANCE OF CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XVI
OF 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on the 14th July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 533.]
[27th May, 1965]
An Ordinance further to amend the Capital Issues
(Continuance of Control) Act, 1947
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Capital Issues
(Continuance of Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965:
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Capital Issues Continuance of Control Amendment Ordinance 1965
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Act XXIX of 1947

THE CAPITAL ISSUES (CONTINUANCE OF CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
THE CAPITAL ISSUES
(CONTINUANCE OF CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
ORDINANCE No. XVI
OF 1965
[Approved by the National Assembly on the 14th July, 1965, see
Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 533.]
[27th May, 1965]
An Ordinance further to amend the Capital Issues
(Continuance of Control) Act, 1947
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
XXIX of 1947.--In the Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act, 1947, in
section 3, for sub-section. (4) the following shall be subs tituted and shall
be deemed always to have been so substituted, namely, XXIX of 1947.:-
"(4)
Notwithstanding anything contained in section 105C of the Companies Act, 1913,
or in any other law for the time being in force, the Central Government may
qualify any consent or recognition accorded by it under sub-section (2) or
sub-section (3) with such conditions, whether for immediate or future
fulfilment, as it may think fit to impose ; and where a company acts in
pursuance of such consent or recognition, it shall comply with the terms of any
condition so imposed, VII of 1913. "
